Photo 1: The iPhone screen shows 'Battery Health' with 'Maximum Capacity: 84%', 'Cycle Count: 1009', 'Manufacture Date: February 2025', and 'First Use: February 2025'.
Photo 2: Side view of the same iPhone, showing volume buttons and a power button. The same 'DANNY TUNEZ' sign is in the background.
The phone appears to be an iPhone 13 or 14 series due to the dual-camera layout and notch design, not an iPhone 16.

The seller claims 'iPhone 16', but the physical design does not match any known iPhone 16 model (which would have a triple-camera setup or different design).
